mapper.select: SELECT profile_id AS profileId, age_household_type AS ageHouseholdType, has_subscription_account AS hasSubscriptionAccount, living_type AS livingType, spending_habit_type AS spendingHabitType, investment_propensity_type AS investmentPropensityType, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profiles (user_id, age_household_type, has_subscription_account, living_type, spending_habit_type, investment_propensity_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ageHouseholdType}, #{hasSubscriptionAccount}, #{livingType}, #{spendingHabitType}, #{investmentPropensityType})
mapper.update: UPDATE profiles SET age_household_type = #{ageHouseholdType}, has_subscription_account = #{hasSubscriptionAccount}, living_type = #{livingType}, spending_habit_type = #{spendingHabitType}, investment_propensity_type = #{investmentPropensityType}, updated_at = now() WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE profiles SET user_id = #{userId} WHERE user_id IS NULL
